notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (gate exit 0; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run retriage-drivers-1-039) and unreviewed: driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null. No human review, no hardware attachment, no hardware backend, no real MuJoCo run and no mujoco-py run is claimed.

WHAT IT SERVES: the recon proposal's 3D T1 scene, models/3D_model_w_whip_T1.xml, as a configuration-only MujocoDriver (device mhs://localhost/whip-targeting, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0, the card's floor). The card's entry symbol modules.simulation:Simulation exists at modules/simulation.py:16; the package loads the same MJCF in place and never imports the clone. cap.world.step.v1 writes action.ctrl to data.ctrl and runs mj_step; cap.world.reset.v1 runs mj_resetData + mj_forward. The model has 54 hinge joints (four arm hinges plus 25 whip nodes with an X and a Y hinge each) and four motor actuators, one per arm joint. Its <option timestep="0.0001"> gives a 0.1 ms lockstep step. The motors state no ctrlrange, so the bridge publishes action.ctrl as operator_required: a step that sets it is refused with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until an operator overlay bounds it, and the package ships site-limits.example.json with an illustrative -10.0 to 10.0 scalar, labelled example only, source operator. That number is not a model or device bound.

SCOPE: the package serves models/3D_model_w_whip_T1.xml, the target-1 scene of the user-facing main_whip.py path (main_whip.py:43-44); the card's models[0] 2D_model_w_whip.xml and the N10-N20 and T2-T6 scenes are not served. This follows the recon proposal. The card's family-config decision and MujocoDriver helper match the runtime, so there is no helper or decision deviation. Simulation itself is not imported: it needs an argparse Namespace and flat sys.path imports (modules/simulation.py:21,35-36), while the bridge reads the MJCF in place.

FAKE: MuJoCo and mujoco-py are not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is the package's pure Python stand-in mujoco module (fake.py). It parses the pinned MJCF for the 54 hinges, four motors and absent ctrlranges, reports ctrllimited false for every motor, uses the model's 0.0001 s timestep, and integrates a placeholder velocity from each control value. It is not MuJoCo: it loads no mesh, inertia, contact, equality, tendon, sensor or camera, and it exposes no mj_getState/mj_setState/mj_stateSize, so the bridge uses its basic checkpoint profile. The fake fidelity is F0 analytic:stand-in mujoco module (no physics); the class-level fidelity keeps the real MuJoCo F1 contract for the unrun sim backend.

NOT COVERED: the upstream Simulation task interface is not served, so its initial posture (modules/simulation.py:98-115), make_whip_downwards call (main_whip.py:129), joint-impedance controllers, objective and 10**6 acceleration instability halt (modules/simulation.py:250-261) are NOT COVERED. The real MuJoCo engine and its contacts, constraints, actuator dynamics, meshes and rendering were not run and no trajectory was compared with the engine. The 2D and T2-T6 scenes are not served. No physical arm or whip is modelled or driven. No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used.

WARNINGS left by the last gate run, all expected and none failing: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the simulator-family fake is the stand-in engine rather than an upstream package class; G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed. No G4.REF_VALUE, G4.REF_BINARY or other G4 provenance warning was raised. check-report.json is regenerated by the gate; the digest above is the digest line of the last gate run. The clone at commit 8025f9f156bf3cf591afbedca18eaa03e3846d4a was read only and was not imported.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Reviewed Simulation and the selected T1 MJCF, including all 54 hinges, four torque motors without ctrlranges, operator-required control bounds, fake reset, stop behavior and BSD-3-Clause provenance. Corrected driver.py and facts.md citations to include the class docstring, forward call and controller-reset loop, narrowed the target-geometry fact, and disclosed that the stop retains controls reused by a later explicit step without action. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The fake gate including repository tests and the strict collector pass with only the documented simulator-family warnings. For the human reviewer: Only models/3D_model_w_whip_T1.xml is served through the raw MuJoCo contract; upstream task controllers, initialization and instability handling are outside scope. The fake is F0, and no real engine was run. Its -10..10 overlay is example operator data; a deployment supplies its own control envelope. The latch pauses stepping without clearing ctrl.
